command: import copy,json; from work import evaluate; reqs=json.load(open('requests.json')); ev=json.load(open('evidence.json')); pol=json.load(open('policy.json')); got=[evaluate(r,ev,pol) for r in reqs]; assert got==json.load(open('report.json')); before=(copy.deepcopy(reqs),copy.deepcopy(ev),copy.deepcopy(pol)); evaluate(reqs[0],ev,pol); assert before==(reqs,ev,pol); base={'claim':'c','conditions':{'x':1}}; p={'required_conditions':['x'],'require_verified':True}; e=[{'source':'old','claim':'c','conditions':{'x':1},'value':{'b':2,'a':1},'verified':True},{'source':'new','claim':'c','conditions':{'x':1},'value':{'a':1,'b':2},'verified':True,'supersedes':['old']},{'source':'bad','claim':'c','conditions':{'x':1},'value':9,'verified':False}]; assert evaluate(base,e,p)=={'status':'supported','value':{'a':1,'b':2},'sources':['new'],'unknowns':[]}; assert evaluate({'claim':'c','conditions':{}},e,p)['unknowns']==['x']; c=e+[{'source':'third','claim':'c','conditions':{'x':1},'value':3,'verified':True}]; assert evaluate(base,c,p)=={'status':'conflict','value':None,'sources':['new','third'],'unknowns':['source disagreement']}; print('checks passed')

arguments.text: Implemented work.py evaluate: validates missing required request conditions; filters claim, withdrawal, verification, and required-condition equality; applies eligible-record supersedes; compares canonical JSON; returns unknown/conflict/supported/unsupported without mutating inputs. Generated report.json from current fixtures. Local fixture, immutability, missing-condition, supersession, verification, canonical-object agreement, and conflict checks passed.

Unresolved limit: supersedes is interpreted as either a scalar source ID or a collection under the 'supersedes' key; the task does not define alternative supersession field shapes. JSON values containing NaN/Infinity are rejected because they are not valid canonical JSON.
